canonRound1100: Round 1100 (2026-10-08): the career club pool grew to every Club Manager league, whole, so canon now also names the pool clubs of src/data/soccerCareerClubPool.ts. A member was matched the way src/lib/soccerCareerLeague.ts looks a club up (the identity key of the club's own spelling, or of its SC_CLUB_CANON spelling, equals the identity key of a printed name), and the name was then carried to every other season in which this ledger prints the very same string for an unnamed member. Nothing else in the file changed. An older sentence in this file that says a country has no pool club, or that only the hand clubs are named, describes the file before this round. 25 clubs in 353 seasons: Arminia Bielefeld 11, Augsburg 15, Bochum 19, Braunschweig 1, Darmstadt 3, Dynamo Dresden 4, Energie Cottbus 6, Freiburg 26, Gladbach 33, Greuther Furth 2, Hamburg 29, Hannover 96 16, Heidenheim 3, Hoffenheim 18, Holstein Kiel 1, Kaiserslautern 17, Karlsruhe 10, Koln 26, Mainz 20, Nurnberg 17, Paderborn 2, Schalke 04 31, St. Pauli 7, Union Berlin 7, Wolfsburg 29.
